title: Turtle
desc: Ramkaran struggles to extract water in a drought-hit village. As thirst grows, villagers search for desperate solutions, revealing the harsh realities of survival and hope.

title: Sangam
desc: Sunder loves Radha and marries her after much effort. But when he finds a love letter, he starts doubting everything and discovers something very unexpected about her.

title: Jai Ho
desc: A former Indian military officer sparks a movement for social responsibility among apathetic citizens, gaining public support but clashing with a powerful political family.

title: Koi Mil Gaya
desc: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, a down-on-his-luck man, learns his real father was a wealthy diamond merchant. But when he seeks his inheritance, he is shocked to find it has been left to a dog.

title: Madgaon Express
desc: Childhood friends Dodo, Ayush, and Pinku head to Goa for fun, but a chain of impulsive choices, wild detours, and hilariously bad decisions turns their dream trip into total chaos.

title: Kahaani 2: Durga Rani Singh
desc: As Inspector Inderjeet investigates the car accident, he discovers that Vidya Sinha may not be all she appears. She has a dark past linking her to Durga Rani Singh.

title: The Hero: Love Story Of A Spy
desc: Arun, an Indian spy, falls for Reshma. When she disappears during a mission, he vows revenge and sets out to punish those responsible.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Saajan Ki Bahon Mein
desc: Sagar is ready to marry Kavita when he meets Sapna, his former love who is set to marry his childhood friend and life-changing facts surface.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Players
desc: Charlie and Riya, master thieves, gather a talented crew to pull off the ultimate heist: stealing a hidden fortune in gold bound for Romania.

title: Zeher
desc: Siddharth, a police officer facing divorce, begins an affair with Anna. When she's found dead, he realises he's entangled in a dangerous mystery beyond his control.

title: Shaan
desc: Two brothers reform after their honest policeman brother is killed. They team up with a former enemy to stop a gangster and his man-eating crocodile.

title: Race
desc: Two stepbrothers run a lavish stud farm and horse racing empire. When they fall for the same woman, jealousy turns deadly-one plots murder to claim love and insurance money.

title: Raazi
desc: Sehmat Khan, a brave RAW agent, marries into a Pakistani family at her father's request. Her mission is dangerous-gathering crucial enemy secrets while risking her life.

title: Gangster
desc: Simran moves to Seoul for a new life, but chaos returns when gangster Daya re-enters her world. Torn between him and Akash, a singer, she faces a heart-wrenching choice.
